title: Keeping a journal going
premise: People stop journalling because nothing they wrote ever comes back to them.

people.name: Sam
does: writes a page in his journal before work
thinks: I wrote about this last spring, I think

thinks.text: Writing it down is enough, I don't need to reread it

people.name: Sam

does.text: opens his phone instead of the book

thinks: I've missed too many days to pick it up again
